name: Slovakia

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 5419451 inhabitants, recorded as 5.419 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Checked on 2026-07-27 against the Register of Legal Persons of the Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic, through its open API. The register carries, for every entity, the register it came from, and that field settles public backing without any need to read a founding charter: the five theatres below all show 'Osobitný právny predpis, ktorým sa zriaďuje orgán verejnej moci alebo verejnoprávna organizácia' — established by a special legal act creating a public authority or a public-law organisation. Bratislavské bábkové divadlo, Dunajská 2319/36, Bratislava, IČO 00164879. Bábkové divadlo Žilina, Kuzmányho 106/6, IČO 36145211. Bábkové divadlo na Rázcestí v Banskej Bystrici, Skuteckého 127/14, IČO 35985381. Bábkové divadlo v Košiciach, Tajovského 736/4, IČO 31297811. Staré divadlo Karola Spišáka v Nitre, 7. pešieho pluku 1560/1, IČO 36103004 in the same register — the Nitra house, which was the Bábkové divadlo Nitra until it was renamed, and which is why a search on 'bábkové divadlo' alone misses it. A control was run in the same register: Združenie BABADLO in Prešov, an active puppet company, comes from the register of civic associations and not from a legal act, so the field does separate the two kinds. Roughly a dozen further entities carrying 'bábkové divadlo' in their name are sole traders or associations and fall outside on the same test. The opening estimate was 3 to 4 while the file's own note already named five towns. The note was right and the number was wrong.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. One establishment retained: the Department of Puppetry of the theatre faculty of VSMU, Bratislava. Criteria read at source: higher education across three levels (Bc., Mgr. art., ArtD.), degree-granting, puppetry named in all three programmes, public institution. Counted by establishment: six programmes, one school. Upper bound held at 1 rather than widened as a precaution, because the page read carries an explicit claim of exhaustiveness: the department is stated to be the only place in Slovakia teaching animated theatre. That is an institution's claim about itself, not an independent census, but it beats no evidence at all.

performances: settled negative, 2026-07-27. The Slovak survey KULT 12-01, run by the Divadelný ústav, publishes national totals only — theatres, ensembles, premieres, performances, spectators — with no breakdown by kind of theatre. The five regional puppet theatres each publish an annual evaluation of their activity, so a figure is reachable by adding five self-reported numbers with five possible reference periods. That was refused as constructing rather than reading. No observation recorded.
